data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 2121 experienced an overall gross prior year reserve release of GBP 1.922 million in 2014, representing a 0.83% release of its opening gross claims outstanding. This favorable development was primarily driven by an improvement of GBP 5.890 million on reinsurance acceptances. However, this was partially offset by adverse development, with deteriorations of GBP 1.621 million in the Marine, Aviation and Transport line and GBP 2.094 million in Fire and Other Damage to Property. Additionally, reserves for the 2011 and prior years of account continued to improve, generating a surplus of GBP 2.2 million. The 2012 year of account, affected by Superstorm Sandy, Oxbow mining, and Canadian floods, showed very little deterioration and improved attrition, contributing to the overall favorable trend. The 2013 year of account, which included losses from the Blue Racer explosion, Julius Klein theft, and EIF Risk Management turbine damage, developed as anticipated.
